documents.text: The Company might someday need to show the work that went into the development of IP that it uses or has used, or to establish that it owns the IP or has rights to it. To help in those situations, you agree to maintain all records relating to the development of any Company IP, and, if the Company asks, to provide those records to the Company. You authorize the Company to act on your behalf (as your agent and attorney-in-fact) in securing all rights related to Company IP and Your IP licensed to the Company under this agreement. You agree to help the Company secure or defend its rights in Company IP or IP under the License in Section 3, including after you leave the Company. For your help after you leave the company, the Company will compensate you at a reasonable rate.

request.instructions: Document v1 is one clause of the agreement we sent. Document v2 is the same clause in the copy the counterparty returned. Decide whether v2 says the same thing as v1. They conflict when v2 changes an obligation, a right, an amount, a rate, a period, a party, a place, a limit, or who bears a risk, even if only one number or one word differs. Spelling corrections, punctuation, capitalisation, number formatting such as 'thirty (30)' versus '30', and a faithful rewording that keeps the same obligation are the same, not a conflict.
